subject: W4-A Task 2 Canonical Reservation Lifecycle Authority

results.suite: W4-A Task 2: Canonical Reservation Lifecycle Authority
invariantsVerified: Canonical reservation with zero events projects initial derived state ACTIVE (current_sequence = 0, latest_event_id = NULL)
Authorized CANCELLATION_REQUESTED command inserts exactly one event into canonical_reservation_events and transitions projection to CANCELLATION_REQUESTED (current_sequence = 1)
W3 canonical_reservations row remains immutable: status = 'INVENTORY_COMMITTED' is untouched allocation truth
inventory_days.booked_units and held_units remain completely unchanged after CANCELLATION_REQUESTED
Zero payment rows, ledger updates, gateway calls, or refund obligations are created (refunds deferred to W4-D)
Exact command replay recovers identical lifecycle event with replayed = true and zero duplicate events or mutations
Command ID reuse against a different reservation fails closed with LIFECYCLE_COMMAND_CONFLICT
Command ID reuse with changed actor, reason, or text semantics fails closed with LIFECYCLE_COMMAND_CONFLICT
Concurrent identical command submissions serialize safely on database locks: exactly one event created, one result marked original and one marked replayed = true
Concurrent different command IDs for the same transition serialize safely: one succeeds into CANCELLATION_REQUESTED, the second fails closed with LIFECYCLE_STATE_CONFLICT
Foreign guest principal cannot transition another guest's reservation: ownership check holder_principal == actorPrincipal enforced fail-closed with LIFECYCLE_FORBIDDEN
Raw Guest/web role (encho_stays_web) cannot INSERT or UPDATE lifecycle events or lifecycle command tables (permission denied via RLS and explicit revokes)
Direct UPDATE or DELETE on canonical_reservation_events is rejected by trigger with CANONICAL_RESERVATION_EVENT_IMMUTABLE
Direct UPDATE or DELETE on canonical_reservation_lifecycle_commands is rejected by trigger with CANONICAL_LIFECYCLE_COMMAND_IMMUTABLE
Legacy bookings.status mutations (e.g. cancelled/completed) have zero effect on canonical reservation lifecycle projection
No public completed-cancellation API or CANCELLED status transition is added; inventory release deferred to W4-B

Role boundary enforcement: web, payment, and composition roles cannot execute lifecycle transitions (permission denied); lifecycle worker cannot execute W3-A direct hold finalizer or W3-B composition finalizer
assertLifecycleWorkerRole rejects broadened, superuser, or non-restricted roles with LIFECYCLE_ROLE_NOT_RESTRICTED

eventModel.immutability: Append-only; trigger raises CANONICAL_RESERVATION_EVENT_IMMUTABLE on UPDATE or DELETE

commandAuthority.fingerprintAlgorithm: sha256(jsonb_build_object(command_id, reservation_id, command_type, actor_kind, actor_principal, origin_kind, reason_code, reason_text))
commandAuthority.immutability: Committed receipts reject UPDATE or DELETE with CANONICAL_LIFECYCLE_COMMAND_IMMUTABLE

concurrency: Row-level lock on canonical_reservations (FOR UPDATE) serializes transitions per reservation; unique constraint on command_id catches cross-reservation collisions

actorScopeImplemented.host: Reserved enum value; fails closed with LIFECYCLE_ACTOR_NOT_SUPPORTED pending host ownership authority
actorScopeImplemented.staff: Reserved enum value; fails closed with LIFECYCLE_ACTOR_NOT_SUPPORTED pending workforce IAM authority
actorScopeImplemented.externalChannel: Reserved enum value; fails closed with LIFECYCLE_ACTOR_NOT_SUPPORTED pending external ingress authority

lifecycleProjection.requestedState: CANCELLATION_REQUESTED when latest event is CANCELLATION_REQUESTED

zeroInventorySideEffect: inventory_days.booked_units is not decremented; booking_holds is untouched; canonical_reservation_nights is untouched; physical allocation remains intact
zeroRefundSideEffect: canonical_payment_attempts, canonical_payment_reconciliations, and gateway balances are untouched; zero refund rows created
security: Restricted encho_lifecycle_worker role with NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION; RLS forced on events and command tables; public and web roles have zero table DML; narrow SECURITY DEFINER procedures execute verified lifecycle commands
limitations: No completed cancellation (CANCELLED) is implemented; no inventory is released (deferred to W4-B); no reservation modification is implemented (deferred to W4-C); no refund or payment ledger updates are implemented (deferred to W4-D); public checkout remains disabled; production payable authority issuer remains legally gated.
